name: MOUSE_HITCH
about: Plan C 3.4 / C8: the mouse accumulator's 15-tick catch-up cap. One synthetic stroke (run with -ChimeraTerrainSynthMouse; source=slate, not a P10 run); await_mouse hitch_ms=1000 sleeps the game thread once inside it after 20 ticks, so the next frame owes >= 30 ticks, applies 15 and counts the rest in ticks_dropped. Gate: python Tools/mouse_gate.py <run dir> --hitch.
